data.name: Anusha
data.gender_notes: Anusha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A pleasing name that symbolizes a pleasing personality, one who is pleasing to God and others. The name Anusha carries the meaning “Pleasing to God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Anusha usually hope their child will grow to embody pleasing to god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In the Quran, Anusha is mentioned as a name of Allah's attribute, meaning one who is always pleasing to God.
data.etymology: Anusha belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pleasing to God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anusha total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: أنوشة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يعني الجمال و اللطف و الحسن
in_arabic.long_meaning: أنوشة هو اسم علم مؤنث من أصل فارسي، يعني الجمال و اللطف و الحسن. و هو مشتق من الكلمة الفارسية 'أنوش' التي تعني الجميل و الحسن. و قد وردت هذه الكلمة في الشعر العربي القديم، و تحمل معنى الفتاة الجميلة و اللطيفة.

in_urdu.name: انوشہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: انوشہ ایک فارسی मूल کا اسم مؤنث ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے خوبصورتی، نیکی، اور حسن۔ یہ نام فارسی لفظ 'انوش' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے خوبصورت اور نیک۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیا میں مسلمانوں کے ذریعہ استعمال کیا جاتا ہے، اور اس کا تعلق اسلامی ثقافت سے ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अनुशा
in_hindi.long_meaning: अनुशा एक فارسی मूल का नाम है, जिसका अर्थ है सुंदरता, अच्छाई, और सौंदर्य। यह नाम فارسی शब्द 'अनुश' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है सुंदर और अच्छा। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में प्रयोग किया जाता है, और इसकी जड़ें इस्लामी संस्कृति में हैं।

in_pashto.name: انوشه
in_pashto.long_meaning: انوشه د فارسي اصلي نوم دی، چې مانا يې ښایسته، نرۍ، او پټۍ دي. دا نوم د فارسي کلمې 'انوش' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې مانا يې ښایسته او نرۍ دي. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ټولنو کې کارول کیږي، او د اسلامي کلتور سره تړاو لري.

in_english.name: Anusha
in_english.long_meaning: Anusha is a feminine given name of Persian origin, meaning beauty, goodness, and kindness. It is derived from the Persian word 'anush', which means beautiful and good. The name has roots in Arabic and Islamic tradition, and is used across various Muslim cultures. It signifies a person with a beautiful and kind personality.

pronunciation.urdu: انوشہ کا تلفظ ہے اے این او شہ

However, it is an attractive and pleasing name that has spread across various communities and cultures due to its appealing meaning. It could be a unique choice for parents looking for a name with a positive meaning that represents a desirable personality trait.

This signifies the importance of being sincere and pleasing to God, and treating others with kindness, compassion, and respect. The name encourages the individual to strive for a pure heart and a beautiful character, which is essential in cultivating a strong spiritual connection with the Divine. In this way, the name serves as a constant reminder of the importance of maintaining good relationships with both the Creator and fellow human beings.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Anusha was a slave girl in the court of Caliph Umar ibn Al-Khattab (634-644 AD). The name Anusha carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Caliph Umar ibn Al-Khattab was the second Rashidun Caliph of the Islamic State. He is considered one of the greatest caliphs in history. Anusha was a slave girl in his court who was known for her exceptional beauty and intelligence.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Anusha remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
